title: Acridine Benzimidazolium Derivatives Induced Protective Microglia Polarization and In Silico TDP-43 Interaction horizontal line Potential Implications for Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.
authors: Revi, Neeraja; Nandeshwar, Muneshwar; Harijan, Dinesh; Sankaranarayanan, Sri Amruthaa; Joshi, Meet; Prabusankar, Ganesan; Rengan, Aravind Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该文研究吖啶苯并咪唑衍生物诱导小胶质细胞抗炎极化及与TDP-43的分子对接，虽涉及蛋白-配体对接，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题TF-DNA结合建模无关。
abstract: Abnormal protein aggregation and associated neuronal-glial cell cytotoxicity lead to a plethora of neurodegenerative disorders. Most of the earlier investigations on understanding neurodegenerative disease progression and cure focused on neuronal damage and restoration potential. With increased evidence on the role of glial cells like microglia and astrocytes in mediating these disorders, more studies are dedicated to understanding the role of inflammatory responses mediated by glial cells and how they lead to neuroinflammation. Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a late-onset neurodegenerative disorder caused by TDP-43 aggregation that affects motor neurons. Pro-inflammatory microglia are considered to aggravate the disorder condition. In the current study, a previously reported molecule with TDP-43 inhibition, 3,3'-(acridine-4,5-diylbis(methylene))bis(1-(carboxymethyl)imidazol-3-ium) dibromide salt (AIM4), is analyzed for its microglia polarization properties along with two other derivatives, 3,3'-(acridine-4,5-diylbis(methylene))bis(1-(2-ethoxy-2-oxoethyl)benzimidazol-3-ium) dibromide salt (ABE) and 3,3'-(acridine-4,5-diylbis(methylene))bis(1-(carboxymethyl)benzoimidazol-3-ium) dibromide salt (ABA). The 3,3'-(acridine-4,5-diylbis(methylene))bis(1-(2-ethoxy-2-oxoethyl)benzimidazol-3-ium) dibromide salt (ABE) and 3,3'-(acridine-4,5-diylbis(methylene))bis(1-(carboxymethyl) benzimidazol-3-ium) dibromide salt (ABA) display the increased ability to maintain microglial cells to anti-inflammatory state and TDP-43 binding as compared to 3,3'-(acridine-4,5-diylbis(methylene)) bis(carboxymethyl)imidazolium dibromide salt (AIM4). This was confirmed from total nitrite levels, mitochondria membrane potential analysis, and molecular docking studies. The selected pro-inflammatory cytokines tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha) and interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta) displayed decreased levels, and anti-inflammatory cytokines IL-4 and IL-10 displayed increased levels, however not very significantly, upon treatment with all acridine derivatives. The compounds were investigated on lipopolysaccharides (LPS)-triggered mouse microglial cells and Danio rerio embryos displaying no significant cytotoxicity and physiological changes (cardiac rhythm), respectively. In molecular docking studies, alanine at 315 mutated to glutamate of TDP-43 directly interacts with AIM4. However, pi-sigma interactions of the aromatic backbone of acridine in ABE and ABA with 313 phenylalanine of TDP-43 along with hydrogen bonds formed between 309, 310 glycine amino acids and imidazolium bromide side chains rendered a stronger binding of these acridine derivatives with the protein potentially inhibiting fibrillation. Conclusion: ABA, ABE, and AIM4 maintain microglia in an anti-inflammatory state. However, more studies are required to understand its interaction with TDP-43 and the mechanism of its anti-inflammatory nature.
abstract_zh: 异常蛋白聚集及相关的神经元-胶质细胞细胞毒性导致多种神经退行性疾病。早期关于神经退行性疾病进展与治疗的研究大多聚焦于神经元损伤及其修复潜力。随着越来越多证据表明小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞等胶质细胞在介导这些疾病中的作用，更多研究致力于理解胶质细胞介导的炎症反应及其如何导致神经炎症。肌萎缩侧索硬化症 (amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, ALS) 是一种由TDP-43聚集引起的晚发性神经退行性疾病，影响运动神经元。促炎性小胶质细胞被认为会加重该疾病状况。在本研究中，对一种先前报道的具有TDP-43抑制作用的分子3,3'-(吖啶-4,5-二基双(亚甲基))双(1-(羧甲基)咪唑-3-鎓)二溴盐 (AIM4) 及其两种衍生物3,3'-(吖啶-4,5-二基双(亚甲基))双(1-(2-乙氧基-2-氧代乙基)苯并咪唑-3-鎓)二溴盐 (ABE) 和3,3'-(吖啶-4,5-二基双(亚甲基))双(1-(羧甲基)苯并咪唑-3-鎓)二溴盐 (ABA) 的小胶质细胞极化特性进行了分析。与3,3'-(吖啶-4,5-二基双(亚甲基))双(羧甲基)咪唑鎓二溴盐 (AIM4) 相比，3,3'-(吖啶-4,5-二基双(亚甲基))双(1-(2-乙氧基-2-氧代乙基)苯并咪唑-3-鎓)二溴盐 (ABE) 和3,3'-(吖啶-4,5-二基双(亚甲基))双(1-(羧甲基)苯并咪唑-3-鎓)二溴盐 (ABA) 显示出更强的维持小胶质细胞抗炎状态及TDP-43结合能力。这通过总亚硝酸盐水平、线粒体膜电位分析和分子对接研究得到证实。所选促炎细胞因子肿瘤坏死因子-α (tumor necrosis factor-alpha, TNF-alpha) 和白细胞介素-1β (interleukin-1beta, IL-1beta) 水平降低，而抗炎细胞因子IL-4和IL-10水平升高，但在所有吖啶衍生物处理后变化并不十分显著。这些化合物在脂多糖 (lipopolysaccharides, LPS) 触发的小鼠小胶质细胞和斑马鱼胚胎上进行了研究，分别未显示显著的细胞毒性和生理变化（心律）。在分子对接研究中，TDP-43的315位丙氨酸突变为谷氨酸后与AIM4直接相互作用。然而，ABE和ABA中吖啶芳香主链与TDP-43的313位苯丙氨酸之间的π-σ相互作用，以及309、310位甘氨酸氨基酸与咪唑鎓溴侧链之间形成的氢键，使这些吖啶衍生物与蛋白的结合更强，可能抑制纤维化。结论：ABA、ABE和AIM4维持小胶质细胞于抗炎状态。然而，需要更多研究来理解其与TDP-43的相互作用及其抗炎特性的机制。
